acceptance_predicates.description: Git and SQLite isolated effects share one immutable operation and recovery contract.
Only the explicitly evidenced apply operation may be considered for dispatch; rollback and unsupported operations remain rejected.
Dispatch decisions are based on concrete exact-revision operational evidence and independent review.

definition_of_done: Exact-head cross-backend and recovery tests pass.
Independent review and hosted Formal/Verify checks pass for the identical product revision.
The formal model remains best-effort guidance and no authorization prerequisite is introduced.

outputs.description: A bounded dispatch decision and its recovery evidence.

gates.description: All evidence and hosted checks identify one product revision.
Every uncertain outcome is write-closed and requires recovery.
A separate review worker passes before any public dispatch change.
